articles.title: Russian bombing of Ukrainian aid centre kills 26 people
articles.summary: The strikes destroyed a school used for aid distribution in Komyshuvakha and injured five people.

articles.title: Fighting returns to Kherson region after longest Ukraine war ceasefire
articles.summary: The six-day pause let hundreds leave Russian-occupied Oleshky before strikes resumed Monday.

articles.title: Zelensky warns Russia could exploit US midterms to launch massive attack
articles.summary: Zelenskyy said the expected strike would target energy and logistics while US attention focused on the midterm elections.

articles.title: Iran says it can reopen Hormuz in two days if US meets conditions
articles.summary: Tehran wants sanctions lifted, frozen assets released and the US naval blockade ended.

articles.title: Romania and Moldova Seal First Joint Defence Procurement Deal
articles.summary: The agreement would let neutral Moldova access EU SAFE financing for military vehicles.

articles.title: Ukraine and Russia both report fake emergency alerts after cyberattacks target apps as limited ceasefire ends
articles.summary: Ukraine said its service was restored after false nuclear warnings, while Russia reported a separate app breach.

articles.title: Shop fridges and freezers across Europe hit by fresh suspected cyber-attack
articles.summary: Retailers in seven countries reported refrigeration systems reaching as high as 50C.

articles.title: Bulgaria’s Presidential Election Winner Pledges Reset with Russia
articles.summary: Iliana Iotova won 57.6% of the runoff vote amid turnout of 29.1%.

articles.title: France launches attempted murder investigation after petrol bomb thrown at police
articles.summary: An officer suffered ankle burns during Saturday’s largely peaceful nationwide protests.

articles.title: Poland’s Rule-of-Law Crisis Deepens as Rival Judges Claim Control of Top Court
articles.summary: A judge blocked from taking office called a Tuesday assembly to approve the court’s 2027 budget.

articles.title: Russia Officially Withdraws From Europe’s Anti-Torture Convention
articles.summary: Council of Europe inspectors had visited more than 450 Russian detention facilities before the treaty withdrawal.

articles.title: Ukrainian Drones Hit Major Oil Transport Hub in Samara Region
articles.summary: Authorities confirmed an air raid, while satellite imagery showed smoke near Transneft’s station.

articles.title: Kremlin Downplays Prospect of Resuming Gas Shipments to Europe via Ukraine
articles.summary: A proposed winter energy ceasefire reportedly included restoring transit through Ukraine with proceeds held in escrow.

articles.title: Human rights group: at least 69 political prisoners in Russian custody have died since February 2022
articles.summary: Memorial linked many of the deaths to illness and inadequate medical care in detention.

articles.title: Trump says aides have ‘concept’ of Canada trade deal
articles.summary: Trump and Prime Minister Mark Carney discussed the deal Saturday after months of reciprocal tariffs.

articles.title: Supreme court rules against Trump over bid to force California to set aside ballots
articles.summary: The disputed ballots involve a Justice Department claim that about 20,000 non-citizens are on California’s voter rolls.

articles.title: Trump to remove Rwanda and South Africa from US trade deal
articles.summary: The removal would take effect in January 2027 under the African Growth and Opportunity Act.

articles.title: UN's peacekeeping mission in disputed Western Sahara ends after 35 years
articles.summary: A smaller UN team is overseeing equipment removal after rival US and Russian resolutions failed in the Security Council.
